source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: In the original source, attachment-added/removed notifications are dispatched from gAttachmentBucket with bubbling; compose-state-changed is dispatched from window. The original port changes attachment consumers to use event.target directly. Later accepted listeners call getComposeWindowFromEvent, which takes target.documentGlobal when present and otherwise keeps target, before attachment and tab conversion. Keep those original and later consumer phases distinct. The inspected comm producer/consumer code supports the shape distinction; native dispatch and extension-tracker normalization were not paired or executed, so this is not a reproduced regression claim.
title: Compose attachment events originate on elements while state events originate on the window
